subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: Should OpenClaw permit one explicitly marked native compaction result to persist after safety-timeout cancellation while the exact wrapper-owned settlement token remains open?
rationale: Source and proof establish the bounded mechanics, but changing the invariant from dropping every aborted compaction result to accepting one timeout-produced result affects persisted session state and requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: After restoring or migrating the shared Pi helper, accept the exact-reason settlement window and require merged-head native and Pi compaction validation.

options.title: Keep timeout fail-closed
options.body: Retain inner chunk partial-summary recovery and timeout guidance, but remove the AgentSession path that persists results after timeout cancellation.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a slow external provider or full gateway run demonstrates the post-timeout persistence path under realistic load.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: After restoring or migrating the shared Pi helper, accept the exact-reason settlement window and require merged-head native and Pi compaction validation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned reviewer and the strongest recent-history match for compaction timeout and helper ownership.
